:::{#def-prediction-function}
#### Prediction function

A **prediction function** $\predfn$ is a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function) that takes a value $\predvar$ of the [input](#def-input)
and returns a [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfnf{\predvar}$ of the [outcome](#def-outcome).

:::
